Since each subject is a separate application, the fee must be paid afresh for every subject applied to. || Visithttp://www.hppsc.hp.gov.in/hppsc. || Click"Apply Online"on the homepage. || Select"One Time Registration (OTR) for Examinations"and complete registration if new. || Log in to the OTR account and view live advertisements on the dashboard. || Select the relevant subject advertisement (e.g., Hindi – 47/6-2026, History – 48/6-2026) and fill the form. || Upload scanned Matriculation certificate, degree/marksheets, category certificate, and Bonafide HP certificate. || Pay theRs. 600 feeonline. || Confirm the undertaking on document legibility and submit the final application. || Download the confirmation/printout for records. || Once submitted, no corrections or modifications are allowed , so candidates should verify every field before final submission.
selection_process: Selection runs through a two-paper written test on the same day, followed by a Personality Test , with final merit based on Paper-II plus interview marks. There is 0.25 mark negative marking per wrong, multiple, or blank answer in objective tests, and the SAT qualifying mark is 45% General / 40% Reserved .
